titre: Housing shortage: 3 million homes short and its causes
resume: As of 2022 the US is more than 3 million homes short of demand, which is why browsing Zillow has become the millennial version of reading fantasy novels. Causes include labor shortages for building, NIMBY policies blocking new construction, high materials costs from supply chain shocks and inflation, and rising interest rates.
texte: That's partly due to housing shortages. As of 2022, the US is more than [music] 3 million homes short of the demand from wouldbe home buyers, which is why browsing Zillow has become the millennial version of reading fantasy novels. >> [music] >> The shortage is caused by a combination of factors. There's the labor shortages needed to build them, nimi policies blocking new construction in existing neighborhoods, [music] and the high cost of materials thanks to global supply chain shocks and inflation.
